2014_spells.dialing-disruption-egw.descr: You disrupt a creature's concentration. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 force damage and if it is concentrating on a spell, it must immediately make a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
2014_spells.dialing-disruption-egw.effec: Deal 1d8 force damage to a target within 60 ft
